name: modularai
description: MODAI: plataforma de paquetes y capacidades extensibles para IA (Core, CLI, registry y gateway de contexto).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @modai/contracts && npm run build -w @modai/sdk && npm run build -w @modai/core && npm run build -w @sorodriguez/modai && npm run build -w @modai/admin && npm run build -w @modai/server && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @modai/admin && tsx watch apps/server/src/server.ts
scripts.test:client-package: npm run build && node scripts/pack-client.mjs && node scripts/smoke-client.mjs
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @modai/contracts && npm run build -w @modai/sdk && npm run build -w @modai/core && npm run build -w @sorodriguez/modai
